items.summary: The prediction market is pitching protection against tariffs, weather and other business risks as courts challenge its ability to offer sports wagers.

items.title: Bitcoin on course to end seven-week losing streak while trailing stock rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) has risen 1.8% since midnight UTC to around $61,600 and is on course to end seven straight weekly losses.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin's Thanksgiving gains prove fleeting
items.summary: Stocks are broadly higher, but bitcoin has slipped back near $60,000, reversing a turkey day advance.

items.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
items.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

items.title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
items.summary: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

items.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
items.summary: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

items.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.
items.summary: Tether says it has returned $1.28 billion in frozen USDT, but victims can wait years to recover their money and face fees of up to 20%.

items.title: Bitcoin tops $61,000 as Nasdaq futures extend Wednesday’s rebound
items.summary: U.S. equity futures extended Wednesday’s rebound after markets closed for Thanksgiving, with AI infrastructure stocks leading premarket gains.

items.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
items.summary: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

items.title: Binance receives in-principle approval, plans Asia hub in Bhutan
items.summary: The agreement is a milestone in Binance’s effort to expand its presence in Bhutan since launching a national crypto-powered tourism payment system in 2025.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.summary: The addition comes as US spot investment products tracking Hyperliquid’s native token reach $266.5 million in assets under management.

items.title: Bitcoin whales pile into BTC despite shrinking profit cushion
items.summary: CryptoQuant data shows Bitcoin whales are breaking with historical fourth-quarter selling patterns despite a market downturn.

items.title: China sets March 2027 rollout for blockchain identity regulations
items.summary: China has issued new regulations governing blockchain-based digital identities, setting rules for cross-platform verification and data privacy.

items.title: Bitcoin price drops below $59K as Anthropic joins tech stock rebound
items.summary: Bitcoin price volatility returned at the Wall Street open as BTC/USD dropped to local lows of $58,700 while stocks and gold headed higher.

items.title: What was Coinbase worth while Nasdaq was closed?
items.summary: A Thanksgiving buyer paid 106.24 USDC per Coinbase share. Whether that looked like a holiday rally depended on when you’d last checked the stock.

items.title: Binance to launch tokenized IPO program after regulatory approval: Yi He
items.summary: Binance is hiring for equity capital markets roles, including an analyst to develop tokenized equity products and assess prospective issuers.

items.title: Brazil’s stock exchange pushes stablecoin launch back to 2027
items.summary: Brazil’s stock exchange is working with six major financial institutions on a real-backed stablecoin that could launch as early as the first quarter of 2027.

items.title: Austria-supervised crypto firms report 20.4B euros in H1 trading volume
items.summary: About 74% of accounts were based in other EEA countries, highlighting the market’s cross-border nature and putting Europe’s supervisory framework in focus, FMA said.

items.title: OpenAI Turns the Tables on Apple With Its Own Trade-Secret Theft Claims
items.summary: The ChatGPT maker’s counterclaims flip the script on a dispute Apple started in July, alleging the iPhone maker took its trade secrets and pressured shared hardware suppliers to freeze it out of the AI-device race.

items.title: Could AI Break Bitcoin? Not Yet, Research Firm K33 Says
items.summary: A draft AI-assisted proof of the Riemann Hypothesis renewed worries about the math securing Bitcoin, but K33 says no cryptographic compromise has been demonstrated.

items.title: $7 Billion in Bitcoin Options Just Expired: Here’s What It Means
items.summary: Bitcoin’s largest options expiry this month comes as traders increasingly seek protection against further losses, with some hedging against a potential drop to $40,000 before the end of the year.

items.title: Hackers Hit US Air Force Cloud System Running Air-Defense and Munitions Data
items.summary: The intrusion at Cloud One, discovered during a system upgrade, has prompted a Cyber Command damage assessment and disrupted the platform that runs air-defense radar feeds, munitions tracking and personnel data.

items.title: Nvidia's Blackwell Chips Turn Up in China as Trump Floats Government Stake
items.summary: Banned Nvidia racks were found at a Shanghai data center tied to Alice Huang, as Trump said the U.S. could still take a stake in the firm.

items.title: AI-Powered GTA 6 PC Ports Now Have Multiplayer as Modders Unlock 30 and 60 FPS
items.summary: Modders have added multiplayer to an unofficial PC port and unlocked higher frame rates on jailbroken consoles.

items.title: What's on the Ethereum Roadmap: Glamsterdam, Hegotá and Beyond
items.summary: Ethereum has rolled out a steady stream of upgrades since 2022. Here’s how those changes fit together—and what’s still ahead.

items.title: Binance Fully Lifts Withdrawal Suspension Four Weeks After $6.4B Hack
items.summary: Binance has restored all withdrawals after October's hack, as the U.S. says it has helped freeze, seize or return $2.9 billion of the funds.

items.title: Kalshi Courts Small Businesses With 'Microinsurance' as State Crackdowns Bite
items.summary: Kalshi says about 500 businesses have used it to hedge risks such as tariffs and bad weather, as legal fights weigh on its sports markets.
